content: Hi there! Let me know if you need assistance with tuition fee matters or digital payment confirmations. The finance office is processing receipts until 3 PM today.
I wanted to check that my son's tuition fee for this term went through. I paid $2,600 by bank transfer yesterday to the account ending in 8934.

Thank you for confirming the payment to account 489382934. If you included your son's full name, Jacob Rivera, and his student ID 1742A in the transfer details, the system will match it quickly. A digital receipt should be emailed to jacob.riv@gmail.com within 12 hours.
Yes, I added Jacob Rivera and his ID 1742A in the memo field. Let me know if you see any issues.

Perfect. Since the payment was received yesterday and all identifiers were included, there shouldn't be any delay. If you don't see the confirmation email by 10 AM tomorrow, please keep your transaction reference 22017654JH handy for verification.
Great, I'll watch for the email. Should I also notify the registrar, or is this automatic?

No need to notify the registrar, our system automatically updates their records once your payment confirms. For urgent matters, you can forward the digital receipt to registrar@rosemontschool.edu, but typically, no action is needed on your end.
Got it. Thanks for your help, and I'll keep the transaction ID 22017654JH saved just in case.

You're welcome! Keeping the transaction ID is smart in case any last-minute issues pop up. If you need further assistance, just reply to this email or call our office at (213) 555-0298 before 3 PM. Have a great day!
